name: Aoyagi Harumichi
source:
A 53-year-old classical musician as well as [url=/c128187]Touya[/url]'s estranged father. Determined to set Touya down on the path of pursuing classical music, Touya's decision to pursue street music, which he deems as "worthless", enrages him.
